svg.desc: GENERATED by `cargo run -p tin-icons --bin tin-icons-gen`. Do not edit: change crates/tin-icons/src/icons.rs.
svg.text: The mark in line: two cans and the slack string. Starts or shows a call.
Cans apart, string dropped: the line is down. No red handset.
One can, the string running off to someone. Small inline places: call history, menus.
End, Decline, Leave: the phone can turned 135°, its string falling away (the playground's
A standing can on a stand.
The can is the speaker: mouth right, two sound arcs.
Speaker can, a small cross where the sound would be.
Smoothed body, lens drawn as a can mouth.
Linked devices: two can mouths face on, a short sagging string.
Direct connection: two ends, taut string.
Through a relay: the string passes through a sealed box.
Smoothed bubble; the tail is a short curve.
Sent down the line: a thrown curve, head on its tangent.
Arc arrow, head on the tangent.
Two people, same shapes as user.
One person and a plus: Add my first contact.
A bell whose mouth is a can rim, for the knock.
Android round Continue: a plain arrow, the circle is the button.
Copy my words: two smoothed cards.
Block: circle and the shared slash.
Paste their card: a board with a clip and two lines.
Share: three ends joined by taut strings.
Save to phone: arrow into a tray.
Download: arrow down to a line.
Play: a softly rounded triangle, solid.
Torch on: a flashlight with its light.
Torch off: the flashlight with the shared slash.
Licences and terms: a sheet with a seal (a gavel reads poorly at 20 px).
Announce: a horn with its sound.
Retire: hints and warnings speak in words (VOICE.md). Kept until screens stop using it.
Retire: the empty chat gets the mark instead. Kept until screens stop using it.
